title: Wireless Security Camera – Dual Lens PTZ with AI Tracking
descriptionHtml:
A noise out in the yard. Three in the morning.

You lie awake guessing: the cat, the wind – or something else? Going out to check is the last thing you want. Not knowing is worse.

The solution: two lenses that see everything – and follow what moves

The camera covers 355° with pan and zoom, and the AI tells people from branches and cats. If someone moves through the yard the camera follows automatically – and your phone alerts you right away.

Features

  • No blind spots – dual lenses, PTZ 355°
  • Alerts on people, not on cats – AI detection
  • Follows the movement automatically
  • Instant notification on your phone – 2.4 & 5 GHz Wi-Fi with app
  • Withstands outdoor use all year round

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
